source_refs.section: What To Do if You Suspect a Phishing Attack
source_refs.applicability: Email or text message that asks you to click a link or open an attachment
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Do I have an account with the company or know the person who contacted me?
source_refs.model_visible_text: On email: If you get an email or a text message that asks you to click on a link or open an attachment, answer this question: Do I have an account with the company or know the person who contacted me? If the answer is 'No,' it could be a phishing scam. If you see signs of a phishing scam, report the message and then delete it. If the answer is 'Yes,' contact the company using a phone number or website you know is real. Attachments and links might install harmful malware.
